description: This file defines the `MeetingsQuickCreate` class, which extends the `QuickCreate` class to provide functionality for quickly creating Meeting records within the SuiteCRM application. It handles setting up the date, time, duration options, and rendering the quick create form dynamically via server-side PHP scripting.

classes.name: MeetingsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that handles the quick creation form for Meetings, including setting up date/time options and rendering the form for AJAX or standard requests.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that prepares the data and JavaScript for the quick create form, setting default values, form options, and handling AJAX behavior.
